subject: Private offer: multi-cloud settlement window & rev-share alignment (Storamark)
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <ecruz@storamark.com>
To: ethan_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Danielle Price <dprice@storamark.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer request — multi-cloud settlement + rev-share ask

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Storamark is excited about Redwood's latency and cost controls. We're ready to move to a private offer, but we need a couple of non-standard points on the commercial side to align with our procurement and finance cadence:

- We need a 60–90 day settlement window (Net-60 preferred, Net-90 negotiable) to align with internal invoicing.
- We'd like to settle rev-share at 18% on the committed private-offer revenue pool across AWS and GCP marketplaces combined. Our standard is 15–20% for partners of our size, and this number is important for our reseller economics.
- We also need an upfront credit of $75k to offset migration and onboarding costs, applied against the first three invoices.

Attached is our PO template and a short procurement checklist. Happy to hop on a call if helpful — Danielle (cc) owns procurement. Can you confirm feasibility and next steps?

Best,
Elena Cruz
Head of Partnerships, Storamark

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Danielle Price <dprice@storamark.com>, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — multi-cloud settlement + rev-share ask

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the PO.

Quick confirmations: we can do a cross-cloud private offer listing that covers both AWS and GCP usage, and we can apply an upfront credit against invoice lines. The rev-share and extended settlement window are outside our standard marketplace templates, so I'll route this to Deal Desk and get an internal read. Lauren and Marcus are looped — could you share any historic ARR or expected monthly spend to baseline the rev-share model? If you prefer, we can treat the credit as a one-time onboarding credit and keep the rev-share a timeboxed pilot.

I'll follow up within 48 hours with recommended next steps.

— Ethan
Ethan Park

Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: ethan_park@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — deal desk assessment and ask for exec signoff

Team — reviewed Storamark request (see attached revshare-model-v3.xlsx). Summary:

- Forecast: $1.2M ARR first 12 months across AWS+GCP (customer-provided cadence).
- Rev-share at 18% produces materially lower margin vs standard 25% on marketplace deals — however, given expected volume and strategic motion into retail channel, a timeboxed pilot is defensible.
- Upfront credit: $75k as requested; propose amortizing as a rebate over the first three invoices (aligns accounting).
- Settlement window: Net-60 is OK; Net-90 raises cashflow risk for Redwood and requires finance signoff. Marcus, please confirm modeled cash impact.

Recommendation for exec approval (conditional):
1) Approve 18% rev-share for a 12-month pilot (auto-revert to standard terms at renewal)
2) Approve $75k onboarding credit applied as a cap-exempt rebate over the first 3 invoices
3) Approve Net-60 settlement. If Procurement insists on Net-90, escalate to Revenue Finance for a protective holdback (5% of invoice) until month+2.

Why approve: preserves competitive placement in Storamark's channel while containing downside via timebox + automatic reversion. Risks: short-term margin pressure and collections timing.

Attached: revshare-model-v3.xlsx (sensitivity scenarios) and draft priv-offer-draft-ethan-v2.docx (legal redlines tracked). Requesting Marissa for final signoff on the concession and cash-credit.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
/stub attachment: revshare-model-v3.xlsx/

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, ethan_park@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 7 Mar 2028 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request — exec approval (Storamark)

Thanks for the detailed analysis, Lauren. I reviewed the model and the strategic rationale. Approve the recommendation with the following conditions:

- Approve 18% rev-share for a 12-month pilot, auto-reverting to standard marketplace rev-share on renewal.
- Approve the $75k onboarding credit, amortized over three invoices as proposed.
- Approve Net-60 settlement. If Storamark signs Net-90, require a 5% holdback to mitigate collections risk; finance must sign off (Marissa: cc Finance).
- Require a 90-day pilot performance clause: if monthly usage falls below 50% of projected baseline for two consecutive months during the pilot, Redwood may terminate the pilot and revert terms early.

Please prepare: (1) final private offer doc (sales/Legal redlines applied) and (2) HubSpot deal update + DocuSign envelope. Ethan — send Storamark the approved summary and the DocuSign link; include a one‑page pilot success criteria doc.

— Marissa
SVP, Commercial GTM
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena / Danielle — great to move this forward. Short summary of approved commercials (per internal signoff):

- Rev-share: 18% on private-offer revenue across AWS and GCP for a 12-month pilot (pilot automatically reverts to standard rev-share at renewal).
- Onboarding credit: $75,000 credit amortized as a rebate over the first three invoices.
- Settlement: Net-60. If Storamark requires Net-90, Redwood will accept only with a 5% holdback until month+2 (Finance-approved).
- Pilot protections: 90-day success clause — if usage <50% of forecast for two consecutive months, Redwood may terminate the pilot early and revert terms.

Next steps:
1) I attached the finalized private offer doc (priv-offer-draft-ethan-v2.docx) with legal redlines accepted.
2) DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/secure/embeddedSigning?token=abc123 — signing order: Storamark -> Redwood Legal.
3) I'll update the HubSpot deal (DEAL-4832) and create the pilot success criteria one-pager.

Can you confirm acceptance or provide any showstoppers by EOD Mon, Mar 12? Once accepted, we'll issue the DocuSign and spin-up the private marketplace listing.

Thanks,
